desc:
BETTY AND REESE'S TOGETHER: The REESE'S flavor you love can be found in delectable Betty Baking Mixes


REESE'S PEANUT BUTTER CHIPS: Made with REESE'S Peanut Butter chips in the mix; Treat everyone to warm, rich brownies with melty peanut butter as a dessert or sweet snack this season


QUICK AND EASY: Just follow the simple steps on the package to create an irresistible and indulgent treat to share; Make brownies a part of food gift baskets or a treats table


HOLIDAY TREAT: Bring out a batch of oven-baked brownies to delight guests at Thanksgiving, holiday parties, and any celebration


CONTAINS: One 16 oz box of Betty Crocker REESE'S Brownie Mix with REESE'S Peanut Butter Chips
features:
Features

  • Includes real REESE’S peanut butter chips in the mix
  • Easy-to-make — just add water, oil, and egg
  • Moist and chewy texture when baked
  • 16 oz box (approx. 15 servings)
  • Kosher certified
  • Fortified with essential vitamins and minerals

Benefits

  • Delicious combination of chocolate and peanut butter flavor
  • Simple and quick preparation — perfect for busy days
  • Great for holiday baking, parties, and gifting
  • Consistently produces fudgy, bakery-style brownies
  • Helps satisfy sweet cravings with portion control
  • Adds festive cheer to any occasion with minimal effort
ingredients: Sugar, REESE'S Peanut Butter Chips (partially defatted peanuts, sugar, hydrogenated vegetable oil [palm kernel, soybean], corn syrup solids, dextrose, reduced protein whey, palm kernel oil, salt, artificial flavor, soy lecithin), Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Salt.
